snippet.title: Can you Escape Heartbreak?-Escape the Room Game [OFFICIAL TRAILER]
snippet.description:
Download on Apple App Store: https://itunes.apple.com/us/app/can-you-escape-fate-escape/id1397298417?mt=8
Download on Google Play now! https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=air.com.jcsoft.canyouescapeheartbreak

Can you use your love skills to save the broken hearts of an insane yandere father’s children before it’s too late?  Collect mysterious clues, defend yourself against relentless bullet hell attacks from creepy skeletons and reapers, experience a heartwrenching RPG story, and survive long enough to uncover the secret behind your own past.  Can You Escape Heartbreak is a free-to-play survival horror comedy escape the room game that drops you into the corrupted world of 2017 and the lingering souls who were left behind. 

You're a love doctor who has the ability to fix any heart, but can you save your own? Between battles, solve mind-bending puzzles and creatively use items to escape the mysterious world of 2017! Can You Escape Heartbreak is a fresh take on a trippy new bullet hell style dodge ’em up that combines fast paced combat with point & click room escape puzzles.

--------FEATURES:--------

FIGHT BULLET HELL BATTLES
3 battles with 20+ unique attacks. Innovative Bullet hell gameplay never seen before! 

ESCAPE THE ROOM
A broken glitchy world with secrets around every corner! See your favorite 2017 Memes brought to life! 

A LARGE WORLD TO EXPLORE
3 enemies to defeat or befriend. Who should you sacrifice and who should you save?

MANY ENDINGS
3 Different Endings to find!
Many secrets and mysteries to solve! Discover the truth under the tale of your own past.

GLOBAL LEADERBOARDS
Challenge your friends to fight for the number one spot on the leaderboards! See how you stack up against the world! 

-----------------------------
Before 2017 breaks down and all is lost, dive under the tragic tale of a love doctor and the New Year. You are the only one who can change your life. How far will you go to fix heartbreak? Can you escape?
Can You Escape Heartbreak: A Zodiac Story is the long awaited sequel to Can You Escape Fate and Can You Escape Love and from the creators of Animatronic Jumpscare Factory and Five Tries At Love!
Note: New episodes will be released periodically. Look forward to new characters and more endings in future updates!
